title: Velvety Rich Australian Beef Casserole
description: A garlicky and comforting Australian dish featuring colatura and a mirepoix base, perfect for a cold winter night, this recipe is also friendly to those who dont like onion or garlic by using alternatives like shallots and leeks.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
In a large pan, heat some oil over medium heat and cook the beef strips until browned, then set aside.
In the same pan, add more oil if necessary and cook the leeks, carrots, and celery until they are softened.
Add the shallots, tomato paste, and colatura to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pan and stir to combine, then add the cooked beef strips back into the pan.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
